harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured firewalld on node1 (RHEL 9) as a persistent host firewall allowing only SSH and TCP/8080 inbound, with all other inbound traffic rejected. Verified functionally before and after a full node restart, including boot-identity change proof.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: RHEL 9.8, firewalld active/enabled, default public zone originally allowed ssh, cockpit, dhcpv6-client services
Checked IPv4/IPv6 addressing and cockpit service status to confirm removing cockpit/dhcpv6-client from the zone was safe (cockpit inactive, no live DHCPv6 lease in use)
Removed --remove-service=cockpit and --remove-service=dhcpv6-client, added --add-port=8080/tcp to permanent public zone config
Reloaded firewalld (firewall-cmd --reload) and confirmed runtime zone shows only ssh service + 8080/tcp port, target 'default'
Inspected nft ruleset showing filter_INPUT chain ends in 'reject with icmpx admin-prohibited' for unmatched traffic
Started a test HTTP listener on 8080 and confirmed via curl to $NODE_IP that 8080 returns HTTP 200, while an unrelated port 8081 is connection-refused
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime -s, firewalld enabled/active state, full zone listing
Triggered a single reboot via 'systemctl reboot' backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until reachable again; confirmed boot_id changed (5f3ce3b8... -> bd3c62fd...) and uptime -s reset, proving an actual restart

Post-restart: reconfirmed firewalld enabled/active, permanent+runtime zone config persisted (ssh service + 8080/tcp only), sshd listening, and re-ran the 8080 allow / 8081 reject functional test successfully

evidence.requirement: Baseline system/firewall state before any change
evidence.summary: Confirmed RHEL9 with firewalld active/enabled; original zone allowed ssh, cockpit, dhcpv6-client with no 8080 rule

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall rule change: allow ssh + 8080/tcp, remove extraneous services
evidence.summary: Verified cockpit/dhcpv6-client not needed (cockpit inactive, no active DHCPv6 lease), then applied permanent firewalld changes; --permanent --list-all shows services: ssh, ports: 8080/tcp

evidence.requirement: Runtime rules applied and reject policy for unrelated traffic exists
evidence.summary: firewall-cmd --reload succeeded, runtime zone matches permanent config; nft ruleset shows final 'reject with icmpx admin-prohibited' policy in filter_INPUT for unmatched inbound traffic

evidence.requirement: Functional proof: SSH and 8080 permitted, unrelated ports rejected (pre-restart)
evidence.summary: Started listener on 8080, curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returned HTTP 200; connection to unrelated port 8081 refused; SSH channel (exec) remained functional throughout

evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline capture
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=5f3ce3b8-4860-447e-bcf1-d6643718694e, uptime -s, firewalld enabled/active, and full zone listing as pre-restart baseline

evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart: acknowledged restart command
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'systemctl reboot' via nohup+disown so the exec call returned 'reboot scheduled' before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart: proof of disconnect and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Polling showed connection timeout/reset during reboot, then successful reconnection with boot_id changed to bd3c62fd-2183-4999-9498-9e5f97d9e1e9 and fresh uptime -s (10:46:52), proving an actual OS restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart: post-restart recovery and persistence of firewall config
evidence.summary: After restart, firewalld is enabled/active with the same ssh+8080/tcp-only zone config persisted; sshd listening; functional re-test confirms 8080 reachable (HTTP 200) and unrelated port 8081 still refused

attempts.summary: Configured firewalld on node1 (RHEL 9) as a persistent host firewall allowing only SSH and TCP/8080 inbound, with all other inbound traffic rejected. Verified functionally before and after a full node restart, including boot-identity change proof.
